blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Heavy rainfall will persist over the provinces of Cagayan and Isabela due to the shear line, according to the state weather bureau on Thursday. The shear line, as defined by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), refers to the line where cool and warm winds converge. READ: No LPA, cyclone expected to form in PH in 3 days Pagasa noted in its 5 p.m. heavy rainfall outlook that Cagayan and Isabela are expected to experience moderate to heavy rains, or around 50 to 100 millimeters of rainfall, from this Thursday to Friday afternoon.
